name: ai-companion-screen
description: 伴屏 AI Companion Screen：Windows 电脑常伴 Agent（开发中）

scripts.desktop:local:build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.mts --mode local-character --outDir dist-local
scripts.desktop:local:package: npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:local:build && node scripts/package-local.mjs
scripts.desktop:public:build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.mts
scripts.typecheck: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:build
scripts.build:public: npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:public:build && npm run check:no-vendor
scripts.desktop:release:package: npm run typecheck && npm run desktop:local:build && node scripts/package-local.mjs --release
